scheme_name: 40% Subsidy On Hank Yarn, Dyes & Chemicals Scheme
other_conditions: Subsidy is available only on purchase/procurement of hank yarn, dyes and chemicals from NHDC, APCO or their depots for self‑consumption by Handloom Weaver Cooperative Societies
Weavers Cooperative Societies cannot claim subsidy on yarn, dyes or chemicals purchased from private dealers or mills
Subsidy cannot be claimed if the purchased yarn, dyes or chemicals are not utilized for production of cloth for members (i.e., if issued and sold to non‑members)
benefits_summary: Provides a 40% subsidy on purchases of hank yarn, dyes and chemicals from NHDC and APCO, with 75% credited as a production bonus to members and the remaining 25% usable by societies for rebates or other production‑related purposes.
